codex_role: audit implementation, reconciliation tooling, and validation
goal: Make every Studio page display accurate, accountable, drillable data with clear source artifacts, DB tables, or runtime files.
requirements: Data presented on Studio pages must be accurate and accountable.
Dave must be able to drill down into data and find the source.
Studio must expose resources that manage the data sources.
Pages with inaccurate or stale data must be updated.
TOD must own an ongoing accountability function that audits Studio data freshness and source traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Studio data-source audit artifact lists page, displayed metric, source file/table, freshness, and confidence.
Training page uses current scoreboard/context-sync validation data and exposes evidence/source links.
Health page reflects current context-sync validation and integration health with source drilldown.
Projects page displays source/evidence for project counts and movement status.
Apps page displays DB binding status and source registry clearly.
Reports page exposes generated report source metadata.
TOD accountability script can be run repeatedly without noisy backup churn and publishes latest validation.
next_action: Build and run the Studio data-source audit, patch inaccurate pages, publish validation, and keep the objective active until all audited critical pages have source-traceable data.
